blocks.text: Child actor Bryce Nicolo Mercader, who starred in the 2026 Cinemalaya film “Kaka Sa Yawan,” has officially joined Viva Artists Agency (VAA). The nine-year-old actor signed a five-year contract with the talent management agency on Thursday, Nov. 12, at the VAA office in Ortigas. Present during the contract signing were Mercader’s guardian, his grandmother Anna Liza Aklan; VAA boss Veronique Corpus; Atty. Jillian Corpus; and his manager, Salve Asis. After the contract signing, Mercader expressed his happiness and excitement over becoming part of Viva, saying that becoming an actor has long been his dream. “Masaya po ako.
